checks.says: dependabot-review.md is not empty and alerts.tsv starts with the exact tab-separated header.

checks.run: awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{ if ($2 ~ /^pr[0-9]+$/) ok=($3=="merge"||$3=="skip"); else ok=($3=="fix"||$3=="dismiss"||$3=="person"); if (!ok || $1=="" || $4=="") bad=1 } END{exit bad}' .moor/artifacts/alerts.tsv
checks.says: Every alerts.tsv row has a repo, a valid action for its kind (alert or PR) and a reason.

checks.run: r=$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner --jq .nameWithOwner); f=.moor/artifacts/alerts.tsv; for n in $(gh api "repos/$r/dependabot/alerts?state=open" --paginate --jq '.[].number'); do awk -F'\t' -v n="$n" '$2==n{f=1} END{exit !f}' $f || { echo "missing alert $n"; exit 1; }; done; for n in $(gh pr list --state open --author 'app/dependabot' --limit 200 --json number --jq '.[].number'); do awk -F'\t' -v n="pr$n" '$2==n{f=1} END{exit !f}' $f || { echo "missing pr$n"; exit 1; }; done
checks.says: Every open Dependabot alert and every open Dependabot PR on GitHub has a row in alerts.tsv.
audit.md has a PR URL or the words 'nothing upgraded'.

checks.run: f=.moor/artifacts/upgrade-prs.txt; [ -s $f ] || exit 1; if [ "$(grep -c . $f)" = 1 ] && grep -qx none $f; then exit 0; fi; base=$(gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef --jq .defaultBranchRef.name); while read -r u; do [ -n "$u" ] || continue; [ "$(gh pr view "$u" --json state,baseRefName,isDraft --jq "(.state==\"OPEN\" and .baseRefName==\"$base\" and (.isDraft|not))")" = true ] || { echo "not an open non-draft PR on $base: $u"; exit 1; }; done < $f
checks.says: upgrade-prs.txt is 'none' or lists only open, non-draft PRs against the default branch.
live-matrix.md exists and live.tsv starts with the exact tab-separated header.

checks.run: awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{ if (!($1=="docker"||$1=="android"||$1=="ios") || !($3=="pass"||$3=="fail"||$3=="n/a") || ($3!="pass" && $4=="")) bad=1; seen[$1" "$2]=1 } END{ split("docker android ios",s," "); for(i in s) if(!((s[i] " base") in seen)) bad=1; exit bad }' .moor/artifacts/live.tsv
checks.says: live.tsv has valid surfaces and results, a reason for each non-pass, and a base row for docker, android and ios.

checks.run: t=.moor/artifacts/live.tsv; refs=$(grep -v '^none$' .moor/artifacts/upgrade-prs.txt | sed 's#.*/##'); refs="$refs $(awk -F'\t' '$3=="merge" && $2 ~ /^pr[0-9]+$/{sub(/^pr/,"",$2); print $2}' .moor/artifacts/alerts.tsv)"; for n in $refs; do for s in docker android ios; do awk -F'\t' -v k=$s -v r=pr$n '$1==k && $2==r{f=1} END{exit !f}' $t || { echo "missing $s pr$n"; exit 1; }; done; done
checks.says: Every upgrade PR and every Dependabot PR marked merge has docker, android and ios rows in live.tsv.

checks.run: p=.moor/artifacts/for-a-person.md; [ -s $p ] || exit 1; for n in $(gh pr list --state open --author 'app/dependabot' --limit 200 --json number --jq '.[].number') $(grep -v '^none$' .moor/artifacts/upgrade-prs.txt | sed 's#.*/##'); do grep -Eq "pull/$n|#$n|pr$n" $p || { echo "for-a-person.md lacks PR $n"; exit 1; }; done; grep -Eqi 'merge|skip' $p
checks.says: for-a-person.md lists every open Dependabot PR and every upgrade PR with merge or skip.
result.md gives the PR URL or 'nothing upgraded', the proposed setup lines and a checklist of actions for a person.

checks.says: upgrade-prs.txt lists at least one PR.
